title: 第1540章 这该怎么打第1539章 我们挑战尊者
content_zh:
长卿想都不用想，魏九凤肯定会对自己放水，尤其以她的实力，想把水放的天衣无缝实在太容易不过了。
“呵，我看你就是怕了吧，没关系，像绝念剑尊那样的高手，怕也不丢人。”
骨幽姬像是终于看出了长卿的一丝窘意，心中大快，拍了拍长卿的肩膀，嘲笑道。
长卿面色如常，没说什么。
待魏九凤宣布了规则后，擂台上的众选手却是迟迟不敢有人率先出手，过了片刻之后，才有一人站了出来。
“玄岳城，楚厉岩，请前辈不吝赐教。”
“哦，玄岳城的大乌龟啊，这规则对他们倒还挺有利的，也难怪他们想先上。”
骨幽姬看了一眼，语气中带着些许的不屑。
一旁的长卿没有过多询问，他一眼就能看出这楚厉岩是战法修士，估计和自己当初对战的那个拓山一样，擅长防御手段。
确实如骨幽姬所说，规则并没有限制选手用什么方式拖延时间，哪怕只是一味防御，只要能坚持下来，同样能得到晋级令牌。
那楚厉岩运转起周身灵力，转瞬九转的气息显露无疑，显然是对自己的实力有一定自信，才敢上前率先挑战。
魏九凤在宣读完规则后，就在擂台中央闭目养神了起来，听到终于有人来挑战，她凤眸轻开，但只是瞥了他一眼，就吝啬般收回了目光。
“准备吧，本尊这十道剑法虚影战力没有区别。”
她冷冷说道。
楚厉岩恭敬行礼，随后催动起御灵，果然都是以防御手段为主，几道光芒闪烁之下，一面如龟甲一般的盾牌虚影凝结在他的面前。
但楚厉岩并没有就此作罢，他大吼一声，再次催动御灵，又是三面龟甲盾牌凝聚在他的左右背后，最后甚至于在他头顶还有一面盾牌。
“前辈，我准备好了。”
能提前准备，对楚厉岩来说显然是又一个巨大的优势，他能提前把防御手段全都施展出来，以他转瞬九转的境界，全力专注于防御，他相信就算是须臾低转数境界的高手，一时半会儿也奈他不得。
“这大乌龟还真是搞笑，前辈让他准备，他还真好意思慢吞吞地弄出五面龟壳，也不怕让人笑话。”
看到楚厉岩的准备，长卿身旁的骨幽姬忍不住再次说道。

“你和他没仇吧。”
一旁的孙墨河有些不解地问道。
在他看来，既然对手是绝念剑尊那样级别的高手，别说是提前施展全方位的防御手段，就是布个灵阵都不算过分，双方的差距太大，没什么可丢人的。
“我和那个大乌龟能有什么仇。”
骨幽姬随口道。
“你很崇拜绝念剑尊吧。”
长卿幽幽开口。
骨幽姬虽然被戳中心思，但也大大方方承认道。
“尊者本就是传说中才存在的人物，绝念剑尊遗世独立，清冷绝美，实力无双，和那些宗门半截身子入土的老头子老太婆完全不同，我们这样的小辈，仰望她不是很正常的事么。”
“咳咳......”
content_en:
Changqing didn't even have to think about it. Wei Jiufeng would definitely let herself go. Especially with her strength, it would be too easy to let her go perfectly.
"Ha, I think you are just afraid. It doesn't matter. A master like Juenian Sword Master has no shame in being afraid."
Gu Youji seemed to have finally noticed a trace of Chang Qing's embarrassment, and felt very happy. She patted Chang Qing's shoulder and laughed.
Changqing's expression remained normal and he said nothing.
After Wei Jiufeng announced the rules, none of the players on the stage dared to take the lead. After a while, one person stood up.
"Xuanyue City, Chu Liyan, please give me some advice, senior."
"Oh, the big turtles of Xuanyue City, this rule is quite beneficial to them. No wonder they want to go first."
Gu Youji glanced at it with a bit of disdain in her tone.
Chang Qing on the side didn't ask too much. He could tell at a glance that Chu Liyan was a combat monk. He was probably as good at defense as the Tuoshan he fought against.
Indeed, as Gu Youji said, the rules do not limit how players can delay time. Even if they just defend blindly, as long as they persist, they can still get promotion tokens.
Chu Liyan circulated his spiritual power, and his aura of nine turns was revealed in an instant. It was obvious that he had a certain degree of confidence in his own strength, so he dared to step forward and challenge first.
After Wei Jiufeng read out the rules, she closed her eyes and rested in the middle of the ring. When she heard that someone finally came to challenge, she opened her eyes slightly, but she just glanced at him and then withdrew her gaze miserably.
"Get ready, there is no difference in the combat power of these ten sword techniques."
She said coldly.
Chu Liyan saluted respectfully, and then activated the imperial spirit. Sure enough, they were mainly defensive methods. Under a few rays of light, a tortoise shell-like shield condensed in front of him.
But Chu Liyan did not give up. He roared and activated Yu Ling again. Three more tortoise shell shields gathered on his left and right sides, and finally there was even a shield above his head.
"Senior, I'm ready."
Being able to prepare in advance is obviously another huge advantage for Chu Liyan. He can use all his defensive methods in advance. With his nine-turn realm, he is fully focused on defense. He believes that even a master with a low-turn realm will not be able to help him for a while.
"This big turtle is really funny. Senior asked him to prepare it, but he was really embarrassed to slowly make the five-sided turtle shell, and he was not afraid of making people laugh."
Seeing Chu Liyan's preparation, Gu Youji beside Chang Qing couldn't help but say again.
"You have no grudge against him, right?"
Sun Mohe on the side asked with some confusion.
In his opinion, since the opponent is a master of the level of Juenian Sword Master, let alone using all-round defensive methods in advance, even setting up a spiritual array is not too much. The gap between the two sides is too big, and there is nothing to be ashamed of.
"What kind of grudge can I have against that big turtle?"
Gu Youji said casually.
"You admire Juenian Sword Master very much, right?"
Chang Qing spoke quietly.
Although Gu Youji was poked into her thoughts, she admitted it openly.
"The Venerable is a figure that only exists in legends. The Juenian Sword Lord is independent from the world, cold and beautiful, and has unparalleled strength. He is completely different from those old men and old women in the sect who have died half-body. Isn't it normal for juniors like us to look up to her."
"Ahem..."
